name: bot_challenge.assess
description:
Record what the current challenge is before you interact with it.

Give your assessment of the tab's current view: the status, what the page or its screenshot shows, and any stated wait. The result records this assessment and says whether the challenge is ready to attempt, still running on its own, cleared or blocked, and whether a tab moved to a fresh browser during the task. It records what you observed and changes nothing on the page or in the browser. Call `bot_challenge.assess` again whenever the page turns into a different kind of block.

To reload the page or move the tab to a fresh browser, request it with `bot_challenge.recover`.
